On TWENEX, saying MACLISP FOO.BAR at the monitor does not start a Maclisp and
run the init file FOO.BAR ... could we look into fixing this? Also, (STATUS JCL)
returns NIL. This is likely because you can only read the JCL once (it goes away
when you look at it) and I bet Lisp is reading it when it loads, but not doing
anything with it... -kmp
